notes: Fresh Sep 9 Toronto-morning B_V1 gate over all 167 judge candidates. Every row was reviewed for entity accuracy and the five B_V1 score components. Accidental ticker mappings (including TRX Gold vs TRON, Stride Inc vs Stride Bank, BYD/Boyd, ICE, FT, ISO and similar common-token collisions), evergreen/prediction content, weak solicitation/SEO evidence and duplicate angles were hard-rejected. Ten distinct events cleared the conservative gate; fewer than 20 were retained rather than padding.
